explication: Scarf is a native macOS and iOS client for inspecting and managing Hermes AI agents locally or over SSH. The main workflow is selecting a host, connecting through its transport, and using the app’s chat or management surfaces to inspect Hermes state or invoke supported actions. The graph includes the documented project, session, skills, memory, cron, MCP, and voice capabilities. Several feature links are README-level; sampled code verifies transport selection, project-context refresh, and voice delegation, but not every UI-to-service call.
